cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The club's changing the menu. Keep that quiet before I tell you the bigger news. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Not even the person you tell everything to?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We've found the first lock to check.
